correctness.rationale: The exact source 21 forms define a nonzero primitive degree-21 hypersurface in every residue characteristic, giving a flat relative Cartier divisor. The explicit verifier performs all 1330 triple determinants in Z[alpha] and obtains norm counts 0:112,1:169,2:228,4:271,8:320,16:156,32:70,64:4. Norms of all nonzero determinants are powers of 2, proving no change outside the split primes over 2. Direct alpha=0/1 reductions give the complete two scheme-fiber factorizations and 6/7-line support configurations. All 49 generic incidence supports are enumerated; their primitive projective-coordinate reductions using alpha or alpha+1 as local uniformizers give the claimed specialization table, independently of choice of line pair. Scope carefully distinguishes these section counts from lengths of nonreduced special-fiber singular schemes.

value.rationale: The exact arithmetic of a famous maximal-symmetry line arrangement is a natural and motivated classification problem: it identifies all bad primes for a fixed integral model, exhibits two different nonreduced flat degenerations above the same rational prime, and tracks the collisions of all 49 distinguished generic singular points. The six-line Fano deletion versus full seven-line Fano arrangement and the precise component exponents are structural, not a routine renaming of previously tabulated complex incidence numbers. The theorem supplies a reusable arithmetic model for studying finite-characteristic line configurations while making no unsupported downstream claims.
